deltas.title_id: DJP Hapus Sanksi Administratif Pajak hingga 100 Persen
deltas.title_en: DJP (Directorate General of Taxes) eliminates administrative tax sanctions by up to 100%
deltas.impact_note: Clients with pending tax administrative sanctions should evaluate acting now - the reduction/elimination size depends on the timing of meeting requirements, so delay reduces the benefit. Implements the sanction-reduction mechanism introduced by PMK 71/2026.
deltas.summary: New Kepdirjen (Director General of Taxes decree) grants reduction or full elimination of administrative tax sanctions for a number of obligations; the size of the facility depends on when the taxpayer's requirements are met. A companion DDTC piece the same day clarifies this is not a general tax amnesty ('DJP: Pengurangan Sanksi dalam PMK 71/2026 Bukan Pemutihan Pajak').
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: DJP memberi pengurangan atau penghapusan sanksi pajak hingga 100% untuk sejumlah kewajiban. Besaran fasilitas bergantung pada waktu pemenuhan syarat.
